name: Bácsszőlős (Hungary)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bácsszőlős: a shield of brown and green with a white pruning knife, two bunches of grapes and a sun, above a scroll inscribed Bácsszőlős.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
